title: T&Cs 2026
html:
Apple Blossom Cattery ("ABC"), operated by Feline Good Ltd, of Cowbridge Road, Talygarn, Vale of Glamorgan (CF72 9JU) provides boarding services for cats. These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") form the contract between ABC and the person(s) making a booking ("you" / the "Client"). By booking and/or delivering a cat to ABC, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

1. Definitions and general

1.1 "Cat(s)" means the feline(s) boarded under your booking.

1.2 "Booking" means the stay dates and services confirmed by ABC in writing (including by email or message).

1.3 These Terms apply to all Cats boarded at ABC and supersede any prior discussions, unless ABC agrees otherwise in writing.

2. Bookings, payment and cancellation

2.1 Booking confirmation. All stays must be booked in advance. A Booking is only confirmed once ABC has checked availability and issued written confirmation.

2.2 No deposit. ABC does not require a deposit. However, ABC may refuse future bookings from Clients who cancel without the required notice or who repeatedly change bookings at short notice.

2.3 Fees are charged per day per pen, including the day of arrival and departure. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, current prices (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027) are: £17 (1 cat), £21 (2 cats), £25 (3 cats) and £27 (4 cats) per pen-day. The interconnected two-pen suites are £60 per day.

Family pen (on request): where you specifically request one of our family pens for a booking of one or two cats, a supplement of £4 per day applies. Bookings of three or four cats are placed in a family pen as standard, with no supplement.

Christmas surcharge of £5 per cat per day applies from 21 December to 4 January.

Pen moves by agreement. Where ABC can only accommodate a requested booking by moving your Cat(s) to a different pen partway through the stay (for example to fit the booking around existing reservations), ABC will offer this to you and, if you agree, an additional cleaning and administration charge of £15 per pen move applies. This charge applies only to pen moves you have agreed in advance as a condition of the booking. A move that ABC makes for its own operational reasons is never charged.

Medication administration (where required) is charged at £2 per cat per day, or £4 per cat per day where the medication is given by inhaler or injection. All booked days, including arrival and departure days, are chargeable.

Minimum stay is 3 days off-peak, 4 days from 1 June to 30 September, and 5 days during the Christmas period (21 December to 4 January), counting the arrival and departure days.

2.4 Payment. Full payment (including any extras such as the family pen supplement, Christmas surcharge, medication, or pick-up/drop-off fees) is due on collection of the Cat(s), in cash or by bank transfer (bank details on request). If payment is not made in full, ABC may retain the Cat(s) until payment is made, and additional daily boarding fees will continue to accrue.

2.5 Late payment interest. ABC may charge interest on late payments at 4% per annum above the Bank of England base rate, accruing daily.

2.6 Cancellation and changes. Notice of cancellation or a date change must be given in writing. The following applies, by reference to the notice given before the booked arrival date: (a) more than 14 days — no cancellation charge; (b) 14 days or fewer but more than 7 days — 50% of the boarding fee for the booked stay; (c) 7 days or fewer, or non-arrival — 100% of the boarding fee for the booked stay (including the arrival and departure days). These charges reflect the difficulty of re-selling cancelled capacity at short notice. Early returns, late arrivals, or a reduction in the booked stay do not entitle you to a refund or reduction; the originally booked days remain chargeable.

2.7 Administration fee for changes. Date changes made more than 14 days before arrival may incur an administration fee of £5 per change.

2.8 Pre-arrival form and emergency contact. Before the stay ABC will send you a link to its online pre-arrival form. Please complete it before you arrive: it records each Cat's feeding, medication and habits, your emergency contact, and a photograph of the vaccination record, so that the team caring for your Cat has everything to hand. You must provide an emergency contact who is contactable during the stay and authorised to make decisions (including veterinary decisions) if you cannot be reached. If neither you nor the emergency contact can be reached, ABC may act in the Cat's best interests.

2.9 Non-collection / abandonment. If a Cat is not collected within 7 days of the agreed collection date and ABC cannot contact you or the emergency contact, the Cat will be deemed abandoned. ABC may rehome or otherwise lawfully dispose of the Cat and recover all costs (including boarding, veterinary, transport and rehoming costs) from you.

3. Arrival, departure and transport

3.1 Secure carriers. Cats must arrive and depart in secure cat carriers. ABC may refuse admission if safe transport is not provided.

3.2 Times. Drop-off is between 1pm and 4pm and collection between 10am and 12 noon, by appointment, seven days a week. This lets us settle new guests in the afternoon and clean between guests in the morning. We aim to be flexible about times where we can, but at the busiest times we sometimes cannot be. Arrivals and collections outside these hours are by prior arrangement only and may incur additional charges. Late collection may be charged as an additional day (or part-day) at ABC's discretion.

3.3 Pick-up and drop-off service. ABC offers a transport service charged at £15 each way for addresses within 20 miles of the cattery, and at £0.85 per mile each way beyond that, calculated from ABC's address to the pick-up/drop-off location. Transport is at the Client's risk.

4. Food and feeding

4.1 Standard diet included. The boarding fee includes adult cats fed on IAMS or Harringtons dry food and Harringtons wet food, and kittens fed on Scrumbles dry food and HiLife wet food (or nutritionally similar alternatives). Alternative brands are always available too. Fresh water is available at all times.

4.2 Owner-supplied food and prescription diets. You may supply your own food (including prescription diets). Any prescription or specialist diet must be supplied by you, clearly labelled, and in sufficient quantity for the stay.

4.3 Feeding instructions. ABC will try to follow your Cat's normal feeding routine. You must disclose any dietary requirements, allergies or sensitivities at booking.

5. Health, vaccinations and behaviour

5.1 Vaccinations. Our licence requires every Cat to be currently vaccinated against feline infectious enteritis and cat flu. A booster must have been given at least 14 days before arrival; where a Cat is starting or restarting its course, the second injection of the course must have been given at least 4 weeks before arrival. For boarding purposes cat flu cover is counted as lasting 12 months from the last injection whatever the product used; enteritis cover is counted as lasting 3 years after a Nobivac Tricat Trio or Purevax booster and 12 months for other products. The vaccination record (card, vet's printout or a clear photograph of it) must be shown on arrival; ABC photographs it into the Cat's record and the card goes home with you. ABC may refuse admission if vaccinations are not up to date, and does not accept homeopathic "nosodes" or blood-test titre letters in place of vaccination. Feline leukaemia vaccination is recommended but not required.

5.2 Flea and worm treatment. Cats must be up to date with flea and worm treatments. If an infestation is discovered, ABC may treat the Cat(s) and charge you for the cost of treatment (and any necessary additional cleaning), £50 for flea treatment (to reflect deep cleaning costs of neighbouring pens) and£10 for worming.

5.3 Neutering and suitability. Unneutered male cats over six months will not be accepted. ABC may refuse any Cat that is pregnant, nursing, aggressive, excessively stressed, or otherwise unsuitable for communal boarding. Cats that turn out to be unneutered and spray during their stay will be charged£50 for deep cleaning the pen after departure.

5.4 Disclosure of health/behaviour. You must disclose at booking any health conditions, ongoing treatments, history of contagious illness, or behavioural issues (including biting/scratching, spraying, or escape behaviours). ABC may refuse to board Cats with contagious illness or undisclosed material issues.

5.5 Medication and ongoing needs. Diabetic, elderly and frail cats are welcome, as are cats with an ongoing illness provided the condition is not contagious. Our team includes members with veterinary nursing experience and we give tablets, liquids, inhalers and injections, including insulin with food, as part of the day. Medicines must be provided in original veterinary packaging, clearly labelled with the Cat's name and dosage instructions, in sufficient quantity for the stay. Please tell us about every medication at booking and on the pre-arrival form. ABC may decline a Cat whose needs it cannot safely meet, and will say so before the stay.

5.6 Veterinary treatment and consent. If a Cat becomes ill or injured, ABC will make reasonable efforts to contact you and/or your emergency contact. You authorise ABC to seek veterinary attention if ABC considers it necessary. All veterinary fees, medications and transport costs are payable by you.

5.7 Behaviour during stay. If Cats sharing a pen fight or are incompatible, ABC may separate them and charge for the additional pen. ABC may refuse admission to (or require early collection of) Cats that are aggressive or disruptive. Aggressive or abusive behaviour by Clients towards staff will not be tolerated.

5.8 Veterinary fee cover. A condition of boarding is that your Cat is in good health on arrival. ABC maintains insurance under which a Cat may be covered for up to £1,500 in veterinary fees (with the first £250 payable by you) for an injury, illness or condition first sustained while boarding with ABC. Cover does not apply to any pre-existing, recurring or ongoing illness, injury or condition, to any condition the owner failed to identify or disclose (for example dental disease), or to any condition shown to have existed before boarding. Any veterinary costs above the insured amount, and any costs falling outside cover, are payable by you.

6. Accommodation and personal belongings

6.1 Sharing. Only Cats from the same household may share a pen.

6.2 Bedding, toys and belongings. ABC supplies all bedding, litter, food equipment, scratching posts, and basic toys. You may bring bedding/toys, but all personal items are left at your risk. ABC is not liable for loss or damage to personal items. Any item left unclaimed for one month after the end of the stay may be disposed of by ABC.

7. Abc's right to cancel

7.1 ABC may cancel a Booking if you fail to comply with these Terms (including non-payment, failure to provide vaccination proof, or unsafe/aggressive conduct). Where ABC cancels due to your breach, the full boarding fee remains payable.

8. Liability and insurance

8.1 Owner's risk. Cats are boarded at the owner's risk. While ABC takes all reasonable care, ABC is not responsible for illness, injury, death or loss unless caused by ABC's negligence.

8.2 Insurance. You are strongly advised to maintain your own pet insurance.

8.3 Force majeure. ABC is not liable for failure or delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control (including fire, extreme weather, power outage, or public health emergencies).

8.4 Limitation of liability. Subject to clause 8.1 and any non-excludable legal rights, ABC's liability for direct losses is limited to the total boarding fee paid for the relevant Booking.

9. Data protection and use of images

9.1 Data protection. ABC processes personal data for booking administration, care of the Cat(s), and emergency purposes, and keeps it in its booking and care system. Booking confirmations and reminders are sent from bookings@appleblossomcattery.com. Our licence requires us to keep evidence of each Cat's vaccination for 24 months, so the photograph of the vaccination record is kept for that period. Other data is retained for as long as necessary to meet legal and operational requirements. You may ask us at any time what we hold about you, and to correct or erase it where the law allows.

9.2 Photographs. ABC may take photographs of Cats for social media or promotional purposes. If you do not want your Cat(s) photographed, you must notify ABC at check-in or at booking.

10. Governing law

10.1 These Terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Any dispute is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact ABC before booking.
